card.name: Less than / or so after a quantity
card.fires_on: The word "less" (or "than" after it) after "of" or "is" before a time or amount limit, and "or" after a single unit of time or measure, as in "a week or two" or "a year or so".

card.writes: It favors approximate-quantity words such as few and less, which fit vague amounts after a time or measure.
card.plain: It spots wording that sets a rough amount or time, like "less than five days" or "a week or two".
